scene.speaker: valentina
scene.bubble: Sofía has got a cold, so today the Club meets at her window — with soup, comics and songs from the garden!
scene.intro: Sofía has got a cold, so today the Club meets at her window! What's the matter? asks Valentina from the garden. I've got a cough and a headache, and I think I've got a temperature, says Sofía from her bed with three blankets. Luna sits under the window all afternoon, waiting. Are you ill? Have you got a stomach-ache? Learn to say what's wrong!

data.voice_note: Voces: Valentina (desde el jardín) y Sofía (desde la ventana, resfriada).
data.script: Valentina: Sofia! How do you feel today? … Sofia: A little better. My temperature is only thirty-seven now. … Valentina: We brought you chicken soup from my grandma. … Sofia: My favourite! Put it in the basket and I'll pull it up. … Valentina: Mateo brought you three comics and Erik made you a card… with a robot on it. … Sofia: Of course with a robot! Thank you, team! … Valentina: Rest a lot. On Saturday you'll be ready for the picnic. … Sofia: Doctor's orders: soup, sleep and friends. Working already!
